title: Decomposing Gorenstein polytopes of large index
summary: In this paper we prove a free-join decomposition theorem on Gorenstein polytopes significantly improving upon results in prior joint work of the second author with Batyrev, Borger, Haase, Kretschmer, and Payne. In particular, as a strong extension of the Batyrev-Juny lattice pyramid theorem it implies that any $d$-dimensional Gorenstein polytope $P$ of index larger than $\frac{d+2}{2}$ is a free join of Gorenstein polytopes.
